explication: Unlimited OCR Works is a document-parsing model with documented single-image and multi-page inference, plus Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang deployment options. In this checkout, the only sampled runtime source is infer.py: its main workflow converts PDF pages or collects dataset images, submits concurrent streaming requests to an SGLang server, and records results. README-described model and deployment capabilities are included, but their implementation is not present in the tree; links to external runtimes are limited to documented relationships.
